_comment: Claude Desktop MCP configuration. Copy to: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json ; Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json . Open it from Claude Desktop > Settings > Developer > Edit Config. Replace EVERY path below with an absolute path — '~' is not expanded and relative paths are resolved against the client's working directory, not yours. Restart Claude Desktop completely (quit, not close the window) after editing.
